items.title: Firefox 152.0.6 ships a free built-in page-summary assistant
items.summary: Firefox 152.0.6 (July 14, 2026) adds a Smart Window that summarizes pages plus anti-fingerprinting and location-privacy upgrades. Update free from firefox.com or menu ☰ → Help → About Firefox.

items.title: Carry one USB for every job — Ventoy boots any ISO free, no reformatting
items.summary: Ventoy turns one USB stick into a multiboot drive: drop Linux, Windows, and utility ISOs on it and pick from a menu. Install free from ventoy.net, then just copy ISOs — no reformatting.

items.title: Hurricane season is here — the free FEMA App sends NWS alerts for Lake City first
items.summary: The official FEMA App pushes real-time National Weather Service alerts, locates shelters, and works offline for checklists. Install free from fema.gov/mobile-products and set location to Lake City, FL.

items.title: Stop trackers selling your data — uBlock Origin blocks them free
items.summary: uBlock Origin is a free open-source blocker that kills ads, trackers, and cryptominers. Add it free from addons.mozilla.org (Firefox) or uBlock Origin Lite from the Chrome Web Store.

items.title: Run AI on your own PC with no cloud and no subscription — LM Studio is free
items.summary: LM Studio is a free desktop app that runs open models like Qwen3 and Gemma3 entirely on your hardware — nothing leaves the machine. Download free from lmstudio.ai and chat offline.

items.title: 🔴 ALERT — Fake "Apple Support" FaceTime Calls Empty Bank Accounts
items.summary: Apple warns scammers are using FaceTime calls (not just texts) to pose as Apple Support or your bank, tricking people into handing over card details, logins, or passcodes. Apple and your bank will NOT FaceTime you about fraud — hang up and call the number on your card. (Source: Malwarebytes, July 14, 2026)

items.title: 🔴 ALERT — Six Zero-Days Live: Patch These Now

items.summary: Open Settings > Apps > Installed apps and uninstall the trialware and 'Get started' cruft; for a safe full sweep I run a debloat script that strips the rest without touching the operating system.

items.title: ALERT — Patch Chrome Now: Two Zero-Days Are Already Exploited
items.summary: Google pushed an emergency Chrome update on July 11 to fix two zero-day flaws hackers are already exploiting. Just loading a malicious page can hand over your machine. Update Chrome (and Edge/Brave — same engine) now.
body: Google pushed an emergency Chrome update on July 11, 2026 to fix two zero-day flaws hackers are already exploiting in real attacks (CVE-2026-3909 in Chrome's Skia graphics engine and CVE-2026-3910 in the V8 JavaScript engine).

You don't have to click anything — just loading a malicious webpage can hand over your machine. Open Chrome → Settings → About Chrome and let it update. Using Edge or Brave? Same engine — update those too.
Daily tip: most browser hijacks ride in through extensions you forgot you installed. Open Extensions → Manage Extensions and remove anything you don't recognize. Takes two minutes, twice a year.
